packageRules.description: The Vite+ toolchain moves as one (ADR 6), so both catalog entries go together
A pnpm bump is never routine: pnpm is what enforces the install policy in pnpm-workspace.yaml, so its release notes get read before merging (docs/standards/dependencies.md)
prBodyNotes: Read this release's notes and migration guide before merging: pnpm enforces the install policy in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, and a bump to it can change what that policy means.
